access_boundary: This record represents the DeepSeek-V4-Pro preview instruct checkpoint (deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro, 1.6T total, 49B active, 1M context) and its deepseek-v4-pro API model ID. The DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Base sibling, the V4 Flash siblings, the dated 0423 and 0813 snapshots, the V4.1 successor line that the API ID routes to from September 14, 2026, and community quantizations and fine-tunes remain separate boundaries.
strengths: MIT-licensed 1.6T open weights with Base and instruct checkpoints plus mirrors and standard Transformers, vLLM, SGLang, and NIM paths
First-party DeepSeek API with OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints, 1M context, and 384K maximum output plus documented NVIDIA NIM hosting
tradeoffs: Checkpoint scale keeps single-node self-hosting heavy despite efficient hybrid attention
Lifecycle churn at verification time: the 0813 official release supersedes this preview and the API ID is slated for routing to V4.1 Flash
